description: Run a chained tool server-side (computation happens in the GripForge compute service). Returns the step-by-step run. status "needs-manual" = the chain stopped on purpose: read manual_hint, fix it (gripforge_mesh_passport) or send the user to `url`, then replay with step=<that step>. mannequin with an item = chain passport → rig → mannequin, a new locker item.

force.description: Recompute fresh blocks too. Default: fresh blocks are skipped.

input.description: Input of a tools-chain tool (JSON object). Disk paths are removed: pass item_id, the server sets its path.

item_id.description: Locker item the chain works on. mannequin without item = the adult canon.

step.description: Replay ONE step (the one you just corrected) instead of the whole chain.

tool.description: Tool id from gripforge_studios: a site tool (passport, rig, mannequin) or a tools-chain tool (glb.stats, glb.lod-verified, …).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (defaults to the key’s workspace).

name: gripforge_tool_run
title: Studios · run a chained tool
